question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a brown present, Bob has a gold present, Claire has a purple present, Dave has a black present, Eve has a yellow present, Fred has a white present, and Gertrude has a grey present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) brown present
(B) gold present
(C) purple present
(D) black present
(E) yellow present
(F) white present
(G) grey present
solution:
Gift colors are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: brown, gold, purple, black, yellow, white, grey.
1. Alice and Eve swap: yellow, gold, purple, black, brown, white, grey.
2. Eve and Bob swap: yellow, brown, purple, black, gold, white, grey.
3. Eve and Claire swap: yellow, brown, gold, black, purple, white, grey.
4. Fred and Claire swap: yellow, brown, white, black, purple, gold, grey.
5. Bob and Claire swap: yellow, white, brown, black, purple, gold, grey.
6. Bob and Eve swap: yellow, purple, brown, black, white, gold, grey.
7. Bob and Eve swap: yellow, white, brown, black, purple, gold, grey.
Alice has the yellow present, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
